name: football-predictor
description: Monorepo: Angular frontend + Node/Express backend per pronostici calcistici statistici

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run start:dev --workspace=apps/backend" "npm run start --workspace=apps/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=apps/backend && npm run build --workspace=apps/frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=apps/backend && npm run lint --workspace=apps/frontend
